data.description: Per previous KT, 66 behavioral tests are skipped. Common patterns include: 1) API mismatches (add_decision, add_hypothesis, add_artifact methods don't exist - use add_note instead), 2) Timing thresholds too tight, 3) Implementation bugs. Start by running: grep -rn '@pytest.mark.skip' tests/behavioral/ to find all skipped tests. Focus on test files with most skips first: test_developer_maintains_state_across_sessions.py (11 tests), test_researcher_expands_queries_stories.py (8 tests). For each test: remove skip, run to see error, determine if API mismatch (fix test) or impl bug (fix code).
data.title: Investigate and fix 66 skipped behavioral tests
